payout_value_note: Tiered by loan amount: $50 each for $5,000-$9,999 loans; $75 each for $10,000-$19,999; $100 each for $20,000+. Both referrer and borrower receive the tiered payment.
payout_quote: PAYMENT LEVELS BY LOAN AMOUNT: $5,000 to $9,999  $50 to you and $50 to the borrower; $10,000 to $19,999  $75 to you and $75 to the borrower; $20,000 and over  $100 each to you and your friend!
steps: Referring member writes their name on the flyer, adds the friend's name, and gives the flyer to the friend.
Friend (new member) presents the flyer at the time of their loan application.
Friend becomes a Levo member (field of membership: lives/works/worships/attends school/volunteers in 29 counties along I-29 in SD, ND, IA, MN) and takes out a new loan.
Referrer receives the cash payment at origination; the referred member is paid if the account stays in good standing and is not delinquent the first 6 months.
catches: Flyer is dated 04/05/24; no end date is stated, but currency of the offer is not explicitly re-confirmed on a current dated page.
The referred friend must be a new member AND take out a new loan to qualify.
The physical flyer must be present at origination to qualify.
Loans paid off or not utilized within six months of origination do not qualify for the referred member's payment.
